This section describes one way of working
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to keep pet travel booking, handoff, and arrival care calm and consistent at Aurelia Skyways. We check documents, carrier readiness, and traveler notes before we confirm any move. <<FACT F091>> If concerns appear, staff pause the file, share the issue clearly, and keep the traveler informed with steady, simple language. <<FACT F103>> The ground team handles carriers with care between services, and the desk records each handoff in the working log. For arrival pickup, <<FACT F101>> We stay polite, protect privacy, and give clear updates so pets and travelers feel supported. Please contact the shift coordinator or the senior coordinator if you need help with any case.
